title: Almaty and Nature Wonders for 18 to 39s
alt: Turquoise water of the Kolsai lakes in the Tien Shan foothills
transport: Group transfers and shared day tours for young travellers

stops.name: Almaty
stops.accom: 5 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Warm city hotel with a sauna and indoor pool

activities.name: Almaty city tour
activities.description: Republic Square and the Monument of Independence, the Presidential Palace, Panfilov Park and Abai Square with the group.

activities.name: Rakhat chocolate factory tour
activities.description: A look round the factory floor of the brand every Kazakh grew up on, finishing in the shop where the bars cost almost nothing.

activities.name: Medeu and Shymbulak resort tour
activities.description: Up the valley to the Medeu dam and the Shymbulak resort, with the Zailiysky Alatau peaks standing over the gondola line.

activities.name: Zelyony bazaar visit
activities.description: The Green Bazaar halls where horse meat, kurt cheese balls, dried apricots and spices are sold off the same long counters.

activities.name: Charyn Canyon sightseeing tour
activities.description: The red sandstone Valley of Castles, a canyon cut by the Charyn river and walked along its floor between sheer walls.

activities.name: Kolsai Lakes excursion
activities.description: The first of the three Kolsai lakes, a stretch of cold turquoise water ringed by spruce forest in the Tien Shan foothills.

activities.name: Kok Tobe mountain
activities.description: The cable car up Kok Tobe for the whole city laid out below the mountains, with the Alley of Lovers at the top.

activities.name: Mega Mall stop
activities.description: A last stop at the city's biggest mall for souvenirs and lunch before the group transfer out to the airport.

program.name: Almaty
program.description: Five nights in the old capital for a younger group, with the city, Shymbulak, Charyn Canyon, the Kolsai lakes and Kok Tobe.

expert.name: Aisha
expert.quote: Built for travellers in their twenties and thirties, so you land in a group rather than on your own. It is also the cheapest Kazakhstan we sell.
expert.tip: Day four runs to twelve hours with two hundred kilometres each way. Sleep on the outward leg and save your energy for the canyon floor.

summary: Six days in Almaty for travellers aged 18 to 39: a group city tour with the Rakhat chocolate factory, Medeu and Shymbulak, the Zelyony bazaar, a long day at Charyn Canyon and the Kolsai lakes, and the Kok Tobe cable car.
included: Included: 5 nights in Almaty with daily breakfast; group airport transfers; Almaty city tour; Rakhat chocolate factory tour; Medeu and Shymbulak resort tour; Zelyony bazaar visit; Charyn Canyon sightseeing tour; Kolsai Lakes excursion; Kok Tobe mountain; a Mega Mall stop on the last day.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Kazakhstan visa fees; meals beyond breakfast; travel insurance; personal expenses.
